warning: Red: WDFW waterfowl, coot and snipe closures (Columbia, Snake and Yakima rivers; Swinomish Spit) and game reserves, which are closed to all hunting. Not drawn: McNeil Island, GMUs 485 and 522, the Mill Creek Watershed and the regulated access areas. Federal refuges set their own rules (Refuges layer).
source: WDFW 2026 Game Bird and Small Game Hunting Regulations; WDFW closure and game reserve GIS layers.
